app.name: funnel
app.subtitle: Cross-channel marketing analytics across 600+ connectors
app.description: Funnel brings all your marketing data, semantics, and business context to your AI agent in one trusted integration covering Google Ads, Facebook Ads (Meta), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads), Shopify, HubSpot and 600+ other platforms. Ask questions like "Compare my spend, CPA, ROAS, and revenue across all my marketing channels in the last 6 months" or "Which campaigns generated the most HubSpot pipeline?" and get the answers right where you do your work. EU customers (data residency): replace the server URL with https://mcp.eu.ai.funnel.io/mcp.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists Funnel workspaces accessible to the current user.

tools.name: load_workspace
tools.description: Loads a workspace's available data: ad platforms, dimensions (campaign name, country, ad group, etc.), measures (spend, clicks, impressions), and metrics (CPC, CTR, ROAS, etc.).

tools.name: search_fields
tools.description: Finds available dimensions, measures, and metrics in a workspace.

tools.name: get_dimension_values
tools.description: Returns actual values for a dimension field within a date range — e.g., campaign names, country codes, ad group names, platform names.

tools.name: query_data
tools.description: Queries advertising data from connected platforms.

tools.name: prepare_data
tools.description: Loads raw, row-level data without aggregation — every individual data point as reported by the ad platform.
